selection_rule: Use the lexically sorted eligible names from the hashed authorized nonsacred allowlist after deterministic exclusion of frozen identities and forbidden-panel identities; select the required disjoint names per split. No model outputs, outcomes, or locked panels are consulted.
split_rule: Family-disjoint; names disjoint across train/dev/test; template-disjoint where generator supports it; twins remain within one split.
materialization: Implementation stage must emit exact row manifests, token-span maps, and hashes before optimizer step 1. This design pass intentionally does not generate data or load a checkpoint.
